acceptance: Issue #3446 has a reply from the maintainer stating the decision.
If planned, a tracker item exists and is linked from the issue.
context:
Source: found on 2026-11-13 while delivering the agent-facing work (PRs BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4202, #4203 and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#152, #153, #154). The reply is the owner's; an agent may draft it from the issue and the platform registry. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.

Owner decision (2026-11-14): an agent drafts the reply into this item; the owner posts it under his own name. Nothing is posted by an agent.
description:
Problem: only three issues have ever come from outside contributors, and #3446 (a request about R data.table) is still open. The independent critique noted that real outside users ask for platforms and correctness, and an unanswered request costs more goodwill than any agent-facing feature gains.

Outcome: the issue gets a reply with a decision: planned with a tracker item, not planned with the reason, or a question back.
